description: This Java class defines a low-level representation of a contact's raw data, including fields such as name, phone numbers, email, avatar URL, and flags for deletion and synchronization state. It provides methods to serialize to JSON, construct instances from JSON, and create specific contact instances, including deleted contacts.

classes.name: RawContact
classes.description: Represents a low-level contact with fields such as name, phone numbers, email, avatar URL, and status flags, along with JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the contact is marked as deleted.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the contact is marked as dirty (unsynced changes).

methods.name: getBestName
methods.description: Returns the best name to display, prioritizing fullName, then firstName, then lastName.

methods.name: toJSONObject
methods.description: Serializes the RawContact into a JSONObject, including non-null fields and IDs.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Creates a RawContact instance from a JSONObject containing contact data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a RawContact with specified personal details and IDs.

methods.name: createDeletedContact
methods.description: Creates a RawContact instance representing a deleted contact with given raw and server IDs.
